# QAZNEDR.KZ — Kazakhstan Geology Industry Platform

> B2B marketplace for buying and selling mineral deposits, mining licenses, and geological services in Kazakhstan.

## About

QAZNEDR.KZ connects mining companies, investors, geologists, and service providers across Kazakhstan's geology and mining industry. The platform facilitates transactions involving mineral deposits, exploration and mining licenses, and professional geological services.

- **Founded:** 2025
- **Domain:** https://qaznedr.kz
- **Industry:** Mining, Geology, Natural Resources
- **Country:** Kazakhstan (all 14 regions)

## Content Types

### 1. Mining Licenses (Лицензии на добычу)
Active extraction rights for mineral resources.
Fields: license number, license expiry, subtype, annual production limit.

### 2. Exploration Licenses (Лицензии на разведку)
Geological exploration permits for prospecting.
Fields: exploration stage, exploration period (start/end), exploration budget.

### 3. Mineral Occurrences (Рудопроявления)
Documented mineral findings and geological discoveries.
Fields: discovery date, geological confidence level, estimated reserves, accessibility rating.

## Minerals Covered
Oil, Gas, Gold, Copper, Coal, Uranium, Iron, Manganese, Chromium, Zinc, Lead, Rare Earth Elements.

## Services Categories
- Geological services (drilling, surveying, sampling)
- Legal services (licensing, compliance, permits)
- Equipment rental (drilling rigs, lab equipment)
- Investment services (due diligence, project financing)

## API Endpoints (Public, JSON)

### GET /api/listings
Fetch listings with filtering and pagination.
Query parameters: page, limit, query, sortBy, sortOrder, region, mineral, type, verified, featured, priceMin, priceMax, areaMin, areaMax.
Response: `{ success: true, data: { deposits: [...], pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages, hasNext, hasPrev } } }`

### GET /api/listings/[id]
Fetch a single listing by ID.
Response: `{ success: true, data: { id, title, description, type, mineral, region, city, area, price, coordinates, images, documents, ... } }`

## Regions of Kazakhstan
Мангистауская, Атырауская, Западно-Казахстанская, Актюбинская, Костанайская, Северо-Казахстанская, Павлодарская, Карагандинская, Акмолинская, Восточно-Казахстанская, Абайская, Жетысуская, Алматинская, Кызылординская, Туркестанская, Жамбылская.

## Target Audience
- Mining companies and nedra users (недропользователи)
- International investors (including Chinese mining companies)
- Geologists and geological survey firms
- Service providers (drilling, legal, equipment)
- Government regulatory bodies

## Technical
- Built with Next.js 15 (App Router)
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Hosting: Vercel / Cloudflare
- Authentication: NextAuth.js
- Sitemap: https://qaznedr.kz/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://qaznedr.kz/robots.txt
